paragraphs: In Gittin 85b he raises an objection to Rav Ashi; Kiddushin 6b reads Mechoza’ah.[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text has Rav Chanin Mechozna’ah addressing Rav Ashi in Gittin 85b, and the alternative Rav Chanin Mechoza’ah addressing Rav Ashi in Kiddushin 6b. Hyman’s two supplied spellings and his description of the objection are retained without a new identity or residence claim.
